title: FoodStacks
description: This mod makes food stack 8 times.
body:
This mod makes items mainly food stack more. So fish, meat, bread and apples now stack up to 8. :) If you for example decide to craft 21 bread at once with this mod, your inventory will be less full. ;)

All new Stack sizes with this mod:
v1.0.0
- Bread: 8
- Apple: 8
- Golden Apple: 8
- Raw Fish: 8
- Cooked Fish: 8
- Raw Porkchop: 8
- Cooked Porkchop: 8
- Cookie: 64
  
v.1.1.0
- Snow Ball: 64
- Egg: 64
- Cake: 8
- Mushroom Stew: 8
- Bread: 8
- Apple: 8
- Golden Apple: 8
- Raw Fish: 8
- Cooked Fish: 8
- Raw Porkchop: 8
- Cooked Porkchop: 8
- **Cookie: 8**

Hi, I am Bat, this is my sixth mod. It is quite small and simple,
I still hope you like it. ^^
